english.note: Use this when rough fabric or another material pricks and irritates the skin rather than when someone deliberately scratches it.

examples.english: This sweater feels rough against my skin and makes me want to scratch.
examples.traditional: 件冷衫好拮肉，我着一陣就頂唔順。
